name: Notes MCP Server
description: Durable working-memory notes: write/append/read/list/rm notes in the thread's notes dir (data/threads/<thread_id>/). Notes survive compaction and thread death - the retry thread starts with them. This is a SEPARATE plugin from the prompt plugin so notes remain available regardless of which prompt plugin (builtin or remote) is enabled.

config_schema.label: Omni Dir
config_schema.description: Root omni data dir; thread notes live under {omni_dir}/data/threads/<thread_id>/

label: notes
